formal_statement: ∃ (gates : List PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) (out : Fin 13 → ℕ), (∀ g ∈ gates, (g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∨ g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or ∨ g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not) ∧ g.inputs.length ≤ 2) ∧ (∃ ι : Fin 1 → Fin gates.length, ∀ i : Fin gates.length, (gates.get i).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not → ∃ j : Fin 1, ι j = i) ∧ gates.length ≤ 38 ∧ (∀ (w : Fin 13) (x : Fin 13 → Bool), PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit.eval ⟨gates, out w⟩ (List.ofFn x) = decide (∃ v ∈ (({0, 1, 3, 9} : Finset (Fin 13)).image (fun u => u + w)), x v = true))
plain_statement: Take 13 inputs numbered mod 13 and the 13 lines {0, 1, 3, 9} + w mod 13. There is a single list of at most 38 gates, each an AND, OR or NOT reading at most two wires, with at most one NOT gate, having for each line w an output wire equal on every input to the OR of the inputs on that line.
title: Search: a list of AND, OR and NOT gates of fan-in at most two with at most one NOT gate and at most 38 gates computing the 13 line-ORs of the plane of order 3
